title: Flaky Tests
description: Identify, diagnose, and fix unreliable tests.

data.text: **Flaky tests** are tests that sometimes pass and sometimes fail without code changes. They erode trust in your test suite and slow down development.

data.title: Common Causes of Flaky Tests
items: Dependencies on system time or random values

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never ignore a flaky test. Investigate and fix the root cause, or remove the test entirely. Flaky tests are worse than no tests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Avoid shared state and global variables
data.takeaway: Write deterministic tests that produce the same result every time.
